_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_

**Bug: `wsToken` read from the wrong level.**  
Line 54 returns the full CoreConfig, so `channelOptions?.wsToken` is undefined. This drops the token from the manager globals, breaking the new token-gated WebSocket upgrade.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-  if (configType === 'DEVELOPMENT') {
-    const channelOptions = await presets.apply('core');
-    // Manager only needs the token currently, so we don't pass any other channel options.
-    globals.CHANNEL_OPTIONS = { wsToken: channelOptions?.wsToken };
-  }
+  if (configType === 'DEVELOPMENT') {
+    const coreOptions = await presets.apply('core');
+    // Manager only needs the token currently, so we don't pass any other channel options.
+    globals.CHANNEL_OPTIONS = { wsToken: coreOptions?.channelOptions?.wsToken };
+  }
```
</details>

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ‼️ **IMPORTANT**
> Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements.

```suggestion
  const globals: Record<string, any> = {
    FEATURES: JSON.stringify(await features, null, 2),
    REFS: JSON.stringify(await refs, null, 2),
    LOGLEVEL: JSON.stringify(await logLevel, null, 2),
    DOCS_OPTIONS: JSON.stringify(await docsOptions, null, 2),
    CONFIG_TYPE: JSON.stringify(await configType, null, 2),
    // These two need to be double stringified because the UI expects a string
    VERSIONCHECK: JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(versionCheck), null, 2),
    PREVIEW_URL: JSON.stringify(previewUrl, null, 2), // global preview URL
  };

  if (configType === 'DEVELOPMENT') {
    const coreOptions = await presets.apply('core');
    // Manager only needs the token currently, so we don't pass any other channel options.
    globals.CHANNEL_OPTIONS = { wsToken: coreOptions?.channelOptions?.wsToken };
  }
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->

<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>


**`CHANNEL_OPTIONS` is not JSON-stringified unlike all other globals.**

All other properties in `globals` (FEATURES, REFS, LOGLEVEL, DOCS_OPTIONS, CONFIG_TYPE, VERSIONCHECK, PREVIEW_URL) are wrapped with `JSON.stringify()`, but `CHANNEL_OPTIONS` is assigned as a raw object. When the EJS template renders this value using `<%- (globals[varName]) %>`, the raw object will coerce to the string `[object Object]` instead of valid JSON, resulting in `window['CHANNEL_OPTIONS'] = [object Object];`.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Proposed fix to match the pattern of other globals</summary>

```diff
   if (configType === 'DEVELOPMENT') {
     const coreOptions = await presets.apply('core');
     // Manager only needs the token currently, so we don't pass any other channel options.
-    globals.CHANNEL_OPTIONS = { wsToken: coreOptions?.channelOptions?.wsToken };
+    globals.CHANNEL_OPTIONS = JSON.stringify({ wsToken: coreOptions?.channelOptions?.wsToken }, null, 2);
   }
```

</details>
